messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: I didn't expect a pool to be part of the debrief.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: It belongs to the apartment building. Five quiet minutes are the part I'm borrowing.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: You've been quiet since we left the garage.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: There was an envelope under the till. Lease renewal. Another month to decide whether that door stays open.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: I thought Sunline was yours.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: The tools are mine. The sign was Dad's. The building belongs to someone with a renewal date.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: Do you want to stay?

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: I want to answer that without a bill answering first.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: Then I'm entering tonight's heat.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Finish it. Bring the car home straight. You don't have to save the whole month before dinner.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: I kept thinking last night would look better on a bigger screen.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: The club heat was tidy. Then Kade asked you to try the longer loop.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: A clean start, a handshake, nothing at stake. That was the agreement.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: You got the handshake. His taillights were gone by the second corner.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: Jules did warn me about the Foundry jacket.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Watch your car here. Fast approach, late turn. Now you're correcting it all the way out.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: So the car wasn't the whole problem.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: No. That's good news. We can afford to fix a habit.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: One more replay?

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: One. Watch the exit this time, not the gap.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: You turned it off.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: You've learned everything that replay can teach you tonight.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: I want another run at Kade.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Later. Calder has five short heats before Jules starts his courier round.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: Five entries. Five chances to make the same mistake.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Five chances to stop making it. One reference mark, one clean exit. Then do it again.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: And the money?

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Small entry money and ordinary jobs. Eli's saved us dinner; the diner owner doesn't accept missed meals.

messages.speaker: YOU
messages.text: Practice, paid work, then dinner. No rescue mission.

messages.speaker: NIA
messages.text: Now you're listening. Tomorrow, leave room on the windscreen. I have some tape.

source_notes: Pool reference uses a relaxed upright resting pose after the initial pool pose was rejected by image generation.
TV replay and dark-screen planning scenes share one apartment and preserve their corresponding reference settings.
